facts.text: Maria took a solo trip to Spain last year and took a photo of a beach with footprints in the sand and a blue sky.

evidence.quote: Last year I took a solo trip and took this pic in Spain.
It reminded me that life is hard but there's still hope and beauty.

facts.text: Maria's solo trip helped her realize the importance of relying on her inner strength and appreciating small moments.

evidence.quote: It made me realize the importance of relying on my inner strength and appreciating small moments even more.

facts.text: Maria's solo trip was described as a transformative experience that helped her grow and appreciate life more.

evidence.quote: Your solo trip was a transformative experience.
It helped me grow and made me appreciate life more.
